items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley and WR DeVonta Smith officially off injury report and good to go for MNF vs Bears. Hollywood Brown OUT.
items.implication: Full workloads expected Monday; no stinger concerns lingering
items.opportunity: Barkley lead back; Smith primary WR

items.text: Bears officially ruled out Caleb Williams (hamstring) for MNF vs Eagles. Tyson Bagent listed QUESTIONABLE after returning to practice.
items.implication: Bears offense heavily downgraded; Bagent or further backup likely
items.opportunity: Pass-catchers (Odunze, Moore, Loveland) see volume but lower efficiency

items.text: Nico Collins listed OUT for Week 3 with hamstring. Texans WR1 absence opens significant target share.
items.why: ETR Sunday injury report fully lists Collins OUT
items.implication: Major upgrade for Dalton Schultz and remaining Texans pass-catchers; Schultz saw 30% route targets last week without him
items.opportunity: Schultz target share spike, red-zone opportunities

items.text: Rico Dowdle listed OUT. Steelers RB coach confirms Jaylen Warren will lead the group.
items.why: ETR OUT list + beat report on rotation
items.implication: Warren becomes clear lead back with checkdown upside vs vertical struggles for Rodgers
items.opportunity: Warren snaps/carries/routes expand; Homer/Heidenreich as backups

items.text: Puka Nacua listed DOUBTFUL (hip/groin); expected out for SNF vs Broncos.
items.why: ETR DOUBTFUL + no practice all week; McVay comments
items.implication: Adams sees elevated routes/target rate; Kyren still featured
items.opportunity: Davante Adams target share and red-zone boost

items.text: Projecting Jaylen Warren (shoulder), Mike Evans (hip), Brock Bowers (knee) IN despite QUESTIONABLE tags. Seeking early clarity on Flowers/Mitchell/Moore.
items.why: ETR internal projections based on practice/news
items.implication: Start them if no further negative news; DFS implications large

items.text: Jayden Daniels OUT (elbow); not expected on IR, Mariota starts. Return possible Week 5-6.
items.why: ETR OUT list; GM says no IR/surgery currently
items.implication: Commanders offense downgraded; McLaurin still viable but tougher spot vs SEA
items.opportunity: Mariota-era target share for McLaurin historically solid but matchup poor

items.text: IN: Malik Nabers, JK Dobbins, RJ Harvey, Travis Etienne, Jadarian Price (among others). Positive for their roles.
items.implication: Full expected workloads; Dobbins/Harvey Broncos RB committee clears with Coleman OUT/IR
items.opportunity: Nabers WR1; Price Seahawks RB depth; Etienne role despite Berry fade

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs sets new ETR ceiling projection record at 44.0 (top 25th percentile sim average) for Week 3 main slate.
With Dowdle out, expecting Jaylen Warren to lead + heavy checkdowns as vertical game has not worked for Rodgers. Projecting Warren (shoulder Q) in.
items.why: Coach comments + practice squad callups; LP practice but projected active
items.implication: Strong RB2/FLEX with receiving upside; ceiling elevated
items.opportunity: Lead carries, third-down, checkdowns; Homer as primary backup

items.text: LOVE Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest rush yards prop (88.5); Dallas 30th in rush D allowing 173.5 ypg.
items.opportunity: High carry share vs weak run D

items.text: LOVE Chase Brown @ PIT: 20+ touches and 15% target share both games; RB7 utilization; PIT allows 5th-most rush yds to RBs.
LOVE Dalton Schultz (@IND, 28% TS w/ Collins out + IND 4th-most TE yds allowed), Chris Olave (vs LV, double-digit tgts, LV allows 18.7 ypr to WRs), Christian Watson (vs ATL, WR8 util, 38% RZ share).
items.opportunity: Schultz routes/targets elevated; Olave air yards; Watson RZ

items.text: HATE Rhamondre Stevenson (@JAX: post-fumble 31% snaps/5 touches; JAX stout vs RBs), Travis Etienne (vs LV: only 49% touches/38% 3rd-down snaps even w/ Kamara), Terry McLaurin (vs SEA: fewest FPs to WRs, low implied total).
items.implication: Sit or fade; Henderson still behind but closing gap
items.opportunity: Henderson snaps rose post-fumble but Stevenson ranked ahead
items.conflict: Some see Henderson takeover; Berry still prefers Stevenson slightly
